Athens Bicycle Club Sunday Lake Hope MTB Ride

Athens, OH · Mountain bike

Athens Bicycle Club Sunday Lake Hope MTB Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Athens, OH. It rolls every Sunday at 9:45 am from Lake Hope State Park, Four Points area. Pace: adjusted to who shows up.

About the Athens Bicycle Club Sunday Lake Hope MTB Ride group ride

A weekly trail ride at Lake Hope State Park. Route and distance get set by the skills of whoever shows up. A club member leads every ride. Helmets required.
